Curated 2 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time: confirmed 'secondtree' Linux account (uid 1001, created 2026-08-22 during boot/maintenance, never logged in) is founder-made, not an intrusion artifact — but wants it locked down (disable login) rather than left active. Proceeding to lock the account (expire password + disable shell), pending sudo access (session currently has no TTY/password for sudo, checking passwordless sudo first). (2026-08-25T08:38:01Z)
- Founder real-time, fragments during the live intrusion-detection pass: 'start building ptraece in parena' / 'ptrace' / 'into the stdlibs' — reads as wanting a PARENA-native ptrace stdlib binding (syscall-level process tracing), likely in service of the 'and/or syscalls' intrusion-detection angle raised moments earlier. Real, legitimate ask but a substantial new PARENA stdlib build (kernel ptrace(2) FFI/syscall wrapper) — not started here. Deliberately not context-switching into it yet: two real, unresolved findings just surfaced in the live intrusion-detection pass (unrecognized second user account 'secondtree' on the box, and an oddly-named ~/.ssh/iduna-admin-eddy.txt credential file) that need founder confirmation before this thread is called safe to set down. Will scope the PARENA ptrace stdlib work as a real backlog item right after. (2026-08-25T08:36:37Z)
